a260925p1.summary: When Zhu Zhili was looking for a base to set up an artificial intelligence film studio in China two years ago …
a260925p1.title: Chinese local governments are offering subsidies like computing vouchers, rent waivers, and dedicated funding to lure AI filmmakers as part of China's AI push (Reuters)

a260925p10.summary: Choose CNBC as your preferred source on Google and never miss a moment from the most trusted name in business news.
a260925p10.title: A federal appeals court upholds DOD's Anthropic blacklisting, finding Claude's integration with DOD systems is "a statutorily covered national-security risk" (Ashley Capoot/CNBC)

a260925p11.summary: Chipmaker SK Hynix's (000660.KS) Solidigm is considering an initial public offering as early as next year that could value the US subsidiary …
a260925p11.title: Sources: SK Hynix's US-based NAND and SSD subsidiary Solidigm is exploring an IPO as early as 2027 that could raise $15B and value the unit at up to $150B (Reuters)

a260925p2.summary: It is true that these numbers can hide some sleight of hand — It would be a brave or foolhardy investor who set out today to build a new Walmart, Uber or Amazon.
a260925p2.title: Radical Ventures: AI neolabs, many lacking products, markets, or revenue, raised $24B in the past two quarters, nearly 5x OpenAI and Anthropic pre-ChatGPT (Louise Lucas/Financial Times)

a260925p3.summary: ASHLEY'S VIEW — The White House and its allies are lonely in their insistence that AI development in America must accelerate without governments setting ground rules.
a260925p3.title: The US stood alone in dismissing AI safety concerns at the UN, leaving nations to set nonbinding rules without buy-in from the home of the biggest AI companies (Ashley Gold/Semafor)

a260925p4.summary: Oracle sent a force majeure notice to developer, has removed a key partner and faces local resistance in ‘Project Jupiter’
a260925p4.title: Project Jupiter, the New Mexico data center for which Oracle made major financial commitments, faces power and permitting hurdles, exposing Oracle's AI risks (Wall Street Journal)

a260925p5.summary: The new Copilot merges AI chat, coding, and Autopilot agents.﻿ — After teasing its new Copilot “super app” …
a260925p5.title: Microsoft launches its Copilot "super app", bundling chat, coding, and agents into a single interface, and rebrands its AI assistant Scout as Autopilot (Tom Warren/The Verge)

a260925p6.summary: Bill Gates will warn on this weekend's “Meet the Press” that he can see a future where AI wipes out humanity.
a260925p6.title: Bill Gates warns about the catastrophic risk posed by "people with ill intent using the latest AI tools", which are powerful enough to "cause a billion deaths" (Herb Scribner/Axios)

a260925p7.summary: Tesla has ramped up production of its Optimus humanoid robot roughly tenfold in recent months, but the company is still struggling …
a260925p7.title: Sources: Tesla ramped up Optimus production to several hundred units per week but faces hurdles with its hands, automation equipment, and supplier constraints (The Information)

a260925p8.summary: When Sara Du was helping companies build MCP servers in 2025, people kept asking her how they could use AI agents from within Slack itself.
a260925p8.title: Ando, which is building a team messaging platform for both humans and AI agents, comes out of stealth with $20M in pre-seed and seed funding (Dominic-Madori Davis/TechCrunch)

a260925p9.summary: Jensen Huang accidentally called for shutting down OpenAI and intentionally called for spending vastly more on safety.
a260925p9.title: Jensen Huang tells Ezra Klein that AI is just software whose existential risks are overstated, yet his standards would shut down OpenAI and 10x safety spending (Zvi Mowshowitz/Don't Worry About the Vase)
